The Planner failed to distinguish between the two spouses and incorrectly selected the earlier one (Penelope Ann Miller) as the answer, ignoring the more recent and well-known marriage to Amy Poehler. This is a failure in synthesizing the timeline of relationships and selecting the correct spouse based on the most relevant information.
